name: Jezebel
description: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: As if walking in Jeroboam's sins were a light thing, he takes Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians to wife and serves and worships Baal, rearing an altar and a grove, provoking the Most High more than all the kings before him. This mirrors Solomon, who followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and the marrying outside the people that the law forbids because it turns the heart to other gods.

note.label: 1 Kings 16: Baasha to Ahab and the Rise of Baal Worship

points: Ahab called Obadiah, governor of his house, who feared the Lord greatly; when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, Obadiah took an hundred prophets and hid them by fifty in a cave and fed them with bread and water, putting his own life in danger to save them.

note.label: 1 Kings 18: The Lord, He Is the God

points: What was Jezebel trying to do? She wasn't trying to merely just destroy one person, one prophet. She was trying to stop the whole prophetic voice out of Israel. She wanted to stop the whole movement. Same thing today: when you see these videos or these congregates speak out against one specific person, what are they really trying to do? Remember what it says: smite the shepherd and the flock shall flee. So their objective is to destroy this whole movement.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

points: Elijah commanded that all Israel be gathered to Mount Carmel with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of the groves that eat at Jezebel's table. Jezebel was the one feeding these eight hundred and fifty false prophets and encouraging them, and Ahab never checked her.

note.label: 1 Kings 18: The Lord, He Is the God

points: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done and how he had slain all the prophets with the sword. This shows the devil on Ahab: he ran back running his mouth about the slain false prophets and never once mentioned that Elijah had brought rain after a three-year drought.

note.label: 1 Kings 19: A Still Small Voice

points: You would think that God demonstrating his power on Mount Carmel, that Jezebel would repent, that the people would repent. But what did that do? That increased her fury even more. Same thing now: the many, many mighty works that the Most High is allowing IUIC to do, instead of getting praised for it, what do we get? Hatred. The miracles that the Most High is working in IUIC is supposed to increase the faith and the works of these other camps. But what is it doing? They're spewing more hatred.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

points: Jezebel sent a messenger swearing that she would make Elijah's life as the life of one of the slain prophets by the next day. She wanted him dead because he had taken away her power and the name she had gotten in Israel through her idolatry. This is the same wicked spirit named in Revelation, the top-notch wicked woman who feared no God at all.

note.label: 1 Kings 19: A Still Small Voice

points: Jezebel came to Ahab and asked why his spirit was so sad that he would not eat, and he told her Naboth's refusal.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: Jezebel mocked his weakness, telling him he was king and should let his heart be merry, and she promised to get the vineyard of Naboth for him.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: They carried Naboth out and stoned him to death, then sent word to Jezebel that he was dead.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: When Jezebel heard Naboth was dead, she told Ahab to arise and take possession of the vineyard he had been refused.
Ahab shares the guilt. He sat by and let Jezebel commit the crime because he coveted the field, then turned his face from the evil and went to claim the reward.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: The Most High declared that the dogs would eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: There was none like Ahab, who sold himself to work wickedness in the sight of the Lord, stirred up by Jezebel his wife.

note.label: 1 Kings 21: Naboth's Vineyard and the Judgment on Ahab

points: The Bible speaks about wicked women and how hard they made it for the nation of Israel. Elisha the prophet sent one of the children of the prophets to Ramoth-gilead to find Jehu, anoint him king over Israel, and then flee. He told him, God sent me to make you the new king, because the original king was wicked: thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets at the hand of Jezebel.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu is charged to smite the house of Ahab to avenge the blood of the prophets and of the servants of the Most High shed at the hand of Jezebel, whose work was to kill the prophets while weak Ahab let it continue.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jezebel, a strong independent woman, was attacking God's prophets, so God wanted judgment on her for not listening to what he said. He said, I'm going to put a king in place who could address you with the right answer from God. And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: The word declares the whole house of Ahab shall perish, and the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel with none to bury her.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Joram, the son of Ahab and Jezebel, rode out to meet Jehu and asked, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many? There's no peace as long as you got a wicked woman in power. And that's what America likes to do: set up wicked women and empower women that go against God.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehoram himself goes out and asks if it is peace, and Jehu answers that there can be no peace while the whoredoms and witchcrafts of his mother Jezebel are so many.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: When Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it, and she painted her face and tired her head and looked out at a window. Armies coming into the city, and all she's thinking about is putting on makeup. A lot of women lead with how they look, not with God on their mind. She thought she was going to impress him.

Bishop: what did she paint her face for? She wanted to entice the foolish men to be on her side with her beauty, but her beauty was superficial. That's what the scripture is showing us about a Jezebel spirit. Sisters, you don't have to overdo the makeup; that look is not feminine.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: When they go to bury her they find only the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands, fulfilling the word spoken by Elijah that dogs would eat the flesh of Jezebel and her carcass would be as dung upon the field.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: They suffer that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce Christ’s servants to commit fornication and to eat things sacrificed unto idols. This Jezebel is not the Jezebel of the book of Kings; two different time periods. But spiritually, if your wife is a Jezebel, you are an Ahab. The qualities of an Ahab: weak, mentally insecure, allows the wife to do whatever the hell she wants. Some of you men listening are Ahabs, married to Jezebels. Jezebel is sitting in here; Jezebel is listening online.

The Jezebel spirit goes outside of her divine order. God gave men a divine order and women a divine order; the Jezebel spirit says, I can do what he does. It hates the prophets of God and feels it is better than you. It is a very aggressive spirit, becoming a man and dominating men: a maneater. That is the woman minister jumping in the pulpit, the one in the video: do y’all see the cleavage on this ho today?, and now even an Israelite sister who knows she is an Israelite teaching on the street with a microphone.
Every woman has the potential of becoming a Jezebel, and the only way she can become a Jezebel is if you are an Ahab: yes dear, I understand dear, jumping when she says jump.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches
